relay.down.message: Can't reach your relay at {relayUrl}. It last answered {ago}, and sends are being held until it's back.
relay.down.description: Standing notice in the popup and settings when the relay has not answered for a while. {relayUrl} is its address; {ago} a short relative time such as “5m ago”.

relay.down.homeNetwork.message: Can't reach your relay at {relayUrl}. It last answered {ago}, and sends are being held until it's back. This address only works on your home network. Away from home or on mobile data? Connect to your home Wi-Fi or turn on your VPN.
relay.down.homeNetwork.description: Same as relay.down, for a relay on a home-network address, with one more sentence on why it may be silent away from home. Same words on Android, iOS and the web console.

relay.probe.same.message: Same relay. Your devices stay paired.
relay.probe.same.description: Result shown after the person typed a new relay address and it points at the same relay as before.

relay.probe.sameUnverified.message: Probably the same relay. It's too old to confirm, but it accepted this browser's login.
relay.probe.sameUnverified.description: Result shown when the new address looks like the same relay but is too old to confirm.

relay.probe.different.message: This is a different relay. It doesn't know your devices, so each one will need to pair again.
relay.probe.different.description: Result shown when the new address is a different relay.

relay.probe.unreachable.message: Couldn't reach a relay at {relayUrl}. Check the address and that it's running.
relay.probe.unreachable.description: Result shown when nothing answered at the typed address. {relayUrl} is that address.

relay.probe.updated.description: Confirmation after the relay address was changed. {relayUrl} is the new address.

relay.probe.notPaired.message: This browser is not paired to a relay any more, so there is no address to move. Set it up again to start sending.
relay.probe.notPaired.description: Shown when the settings page is asked to move an address but this browser has been unpaired meanwhile.

relay.access.denied.message: Tabsend can't reach this relay without your permission. Try again and choose Allow.
relay.access.denied.description: Shown when the person said no to the browser's permission prompt for the relay. “Allow” is the button in the browser's prompt.

relay.access.missing.message: Tabsend needs your permission to reach your relay at {relayUrl}. Until then, sends are held here.
relay.access.missing.description: Shown when the browser's permission for the relay was removed. {relayUrl} is the relay's address.

relay.access.allow.description: Button in settings that asks the browser for the permission again.

relay.access.openSettings.description: Button in the popup that opens Tabsend's settings, where the permission is asked for.

relay.switch.pending.description: Settings note: a move to another relay was started but not finished. {relayUrl} is the new relay's address.

relay.switch.pendingSafe.message: This browser still sends and receives on {relayUrl} until you finish.
relay.switch.pendingSafe.description: Reassurance under that note. {relayUrl} is the current relay's address.

relay.switch.pendingUnpaired.message: This browser is not paired to any relay, so it cannot send or receive until you finish.
relay.switch.pendingUnpaired.description: Replaces the reassurance when the browser has no current relay.

relay.switch.target.description: Setup page note: which relay the browser is being set up on. {relayUrl} is its address.

relay.switch.cost.message: You stay paired to {relayUrl} until this browser is accepted. After that it leaves that group, and any device you want to keep pairs again here.
relay.switch.cost.description: Setup page note spelling out the one-way step of moving to another relay. {relayUrl} is the current relay's address.

relay.switch.keep.description: Button on the setup page that cancels the move and keeps the current relay. {relayUrl} is the current relay's address. Keep it short.

relay.switch.reusedLink.message: This is the link you pasted in settings. Setup links work once and expire, so make a new one if the relay refuses it.
relay.switch.reusedLink.description: Hint shown when the setup link field was filled in from the link the person pasted in settings.

relay.change.unreachable.message: Couldn't reach a relay at {relayUrl} any more. Nothing was changed.
relay.change.unreachable.description: Error when the relay stopped answering between the check and the confirmation. {relayUrl} is its address.

relay.change.differentRelay.message: That address answers as a different relay now. Nothing was changed. Check it again.
relay.change.differentRelay.description: Error when the address now points at a different relay than when it was checked.

relay.change.tokenRejected.message: That relay stopped recognising this browser. Nothing was changed. Check the address again.
relay.change.tokenRejected.description: Error when the relay no longer accepts this browser.

relay.change.probeFailed.message: The relay refused the check: {detail} Nothing was changed.
relay.change.probeFailed.description: Error when the relay refused the check of a new relay address. {detail} is the reason, one whole sentence of its own that ends with a full stop (such as “Your relay is busy right now. Give it a moment and try again.”). Place it after the colon as it is.

relay.solo.body.message: No other devices are set up on {relayUrl}. They may be on a different relay address.
relay.solo.body.description: Notice when this browser is alone in its group for a while. {relayUrl} is the relay's address.
